The rushed appointments, the failure to listen to our concerns, the lack of proper and unnecessary testing - it all added up to a tragedy that didn’t have to happen. This hospital treated her like a SOURCE of REVENUE, not a HUMAN BEING fighting for her life.

To anyone reading this:

PLEASE get a second opinion. Ask questions. Demand answers. Don’t trust blindly like we did.

If this review saves even one person from what we went through, then maybe her death won’t be completely meaningless.

We will never get her back. Don’t let this happen to your family.

My wife had the Carewel file from her previous pregnancy which she carried  with her yesterday while visiting Carewel hospital. Dr Vaishali Ghiya was clearly upset that we chose to go to the second hospital on our list last time.

There are some people in life whom you can never thank enough, and for us, Dr. Nand Kishor Kabra and the entire NICU team at Surya Hospital will always be among them.

As parents of an extremely premature baby born at just 28 weeks and weighing barely 1 kg, we entered the NICU with fear, uncertainty, and shattered hearts. Those days were the most emotionally difficult days of our lives. But from the very beginning, Dr. Kabra gave us something priceless — hope.

His calmness, knowledge, confidence, and years of expertise in neonatology made us feel that our tiny baby was in the safest hands possible. Every decision was explained with patience, every setback was handled with immense care, and every tiny milestone was celebrated with us. What truly sets Dr. Kabra apart is not just his brilliance as a neonatologist, but the compassion and humanity with which he treats both babies and parents.

Today, seeing our little Ashriel growing, smiling, vocalizing, and filling our home with life feels nothing short of a miracle, and we know a huge part of that miracle belongs to Dr. Kabra and the wonderful NICU team at Surya Hospital.

We will forever remain grateful to Surya Hospital for giving our tiny fighter the best possible start to life. Thank you for your dedication, your kindness, and for standing beside families during their most vulnerable moments. You don’t just treat babies — you save dreams, families, and futures.

Forever grateful.

However, with a little hope, I decided to take a second opinion in Mumbai. After researching good fetal medicine experts, we came across Dr. Pooja Jain.

When we visited Dr. Pooja Jain, I had mixed feelings about what she would say about my baby. But she explained everything about BPS in babies and reassured us about the chances of survival. My husband and I felt so relieved after learning that babies with BPS can have a good chance of survival.

She kept monitoring my baby’s lung lesion, and finally, during one of the ultrasound appointments, the lesion had completely
resolved. Today, I have a cute little baby boy, all because of Dr. Pooja Jain.

A big thank you to Dr. Pooja Jain for giving us hope and guiding us through such a difficult journey.
